mentions.name: 10/GUI macOS window manager
mentions.description: A window manager for macOS based on the author's 2009 concept video 10/GUI. It manages windows in a novel way that macOS does not natively allow, using a set of tricks to maintain the illusion of lower-level compositor access. It is in active dogfooding during development, with a full announcement and beta planned within a few weeks.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the past four months, I've been building a window manager for MacOS based on my 2009 concept video 10/GUI.
mentions.author: mortenjorck
